title: Design System: SACC — Sana Al-Awael Contracting Company

referenceImplementation.approvedProposal: the paper prototype (prototype-paper/), with the owner decisions recorded after approval

paper.note: Page ground, fixed bar, drawer, floating cards, logo plates, inputs; text on ink and photographs.

ink.note: Text, column rules, dark buttons, footer, and the rgba(54,64,68,…) multiply veil over photographs.

ink-2.note: Secondary text: leads, column text, hints, placeholders, unselected choices.

slate.note: Interactive accent: links, focus ring, selected underline, dark-button hover, photo panel ground.

line.note: Row hairlines, bar edge, photo placeholder; 45% as hover wash.

mute.note: Muted half of two-tone headings, journey years, input borders. Large text or borders only.

band-cream.note: Approvals band and success notice. Owner-added, outside the ten-colour list.

plate.note: Hover tint for rows, pager and file button; expertise tags. Owner-added.

declaredUnused.note: Declared in :root but used by no shipped rule; not part of the working system.

contrast.use: body text and headings on paper
muted heading half (large text only); input border
text on dark buttons and the footer
text on a hovered dark button
secondary text on the approvals band
text on plate tags and hover tint

display.purpose: Home hero H1 (company name), paper on the photograph. Arabic line-height 1.5.

headline-page.purpose: The one H1 of each inner page. Arabic line-height 1.4.

headline.purpose: Section H2, two-tone (ink, then Mute Grey). Latin -0.01em; Arabic line-height 1.4.

figure.purpose: The three hero figures; tabular lining numerals, isolated LTR.

subhead.purpose: Inner-page sub-sections and form titles; muted half in Ink Two.

title.purpose: H3 in ruled columns and journey titles (15px in plain columns). Arabic line-height 1.6.

title-small.purpose: Titles in the five-across discipline row.

small-3.purpose: Leads, buttons, nav links, field labels, inputs. Arabic 15px.

small-2.purpose: Column text, section buttons, hints, footer. Arabic 14px.

weightSlots.note: CSS weight slot to rendered face, identical for Arabic and Latin (fonts.css).

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: White cards floating on a photo panel only.

shadows.name: cta-frame
shadows.purpose: The translucent frame (20% white fill, 8px) around the hero action.

veils.name: hero
veils.value: multiply; top band 0.84 to 22%, central ellipse 0.8/0.74 behind the text, foot 0.82–0.9 from 66%, base 0.3; all rgba(54,64,68,…)
veils.purpose: Hero photograph; under 941px a single vertical gradient.

veils.name: project-card
veils.purpose: Project cards: dark at the meta row and the title, light between.

veils.name: panel-blur
veils.value: filter: blur(18px) saturate(0.85); opacity 0.9 over slate

motion.name: press
motion.value: scale(0.97) buttons, file button, choices; 0.94 icon buttons; 0.985 project cards and pager; 0.99 GM card; translateY(1px) linked columns; 160ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Every pressable thing answers a press.

motion.name: hover-gate
motion.purpose: All hover effects; none on touch.

motion.name: photo-zoom
motion.purpose: Project card photo on hover or focus.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: opacity 0→1, translateY(10px→0); hero 600ms with 70ms steps; sections 500ms with 50ms × --i stagger
motion.purpose: Entrances, once; content on screen at load is left alone.

motion.name: marquee
motion.value: linear 48s (40s under 560px), translateX(calc(var(--dir) * -50%)), paused on hover and focus-within

motion.name: bar-swap
motion.purpose: Home bar from transparent to white.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transitions limited to opacity, color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow
motion.purpose: Less motion, not none; marquee static and centred.

breakpoints.name: grids
breakpoints.note: columns drop: disciplines 5→3, others 3/4→2, project cards 3→2

breakpoints.name: nav
breakpoints.note: nav to drawer; bar 56px; hero no longer inset, bar no longer over it

breakpoints.name: panel
breakpoints.note: leadership panel stacks; logo plates 4→3; careers points 4→2

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.note: split, form grid and office stack

breakpoints.name: rows
breakpoints.note: ISO tiles to rows; list rows and roles compact

breakpoints.name: single
breakpoints.note: ruled columns 1-up (disciplines 2-up); linked-column arrows always shown

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: project cards 1-up at 2:1; logo plates 2-up; pager stacks

focus.onDark: outline-color #FFFFFF inside .on-dark (hero, project cards, footer); the bar uses its own text colour

background.purpose: White paper ground by the owner's instruction; theme-color #FFFFFF.

narrative.northStar: The Ruled Ledger on White Paper
narrative.overview:
The site reads as a formal, well-set document on a plain white sheet. Headings are a warm Arabic-Latin display face (El Messiri) in two tones, ink then a muted grey. Content below them sits in ruled columns: a firm 1px ink rule over each item, the title and a short line under it, and no fill or box. The owner tried pale beige plates and found they read as sticky notes, so the rule replaced the plate everywhere: disciplines, values, scope of work, ISO standards, the office and the careers points. Colour is nearly absent. It is the owner's ink, slate and grey on white, with one cream band for the approvals.

Photographs carry the emotion. The hero, the project cards and the leadership panel are real field photographs darkened by an ink-coloured multiply veil, so off-white type sits on them at full contrast without the photo going grey. Proof is named, never claimed: three hero figures, seven approving bodies shown by their official logos, three ISO standards, named projects and named leaders.

Arabic is the root language. Layout is written in logical properties so the English page under /en mirrors without overrides, and every arrow, slide and marquee direction follows the reading direction. The page is calm and small-scaled, matching the owner's reference: body text around 15.5px, small text on a three-step scale, headings that stop at 54px.
keyCharacteristics: White paper ground; ink text; slate for links, focus and selection; one cream band.
El Messiri headings in two tones (ink, then muted grey); Tajawal for all other text, at bold weights.
Ruled columns (1px ink top rule, no fill) instead of cards or plates.
Photographs under an ink multiply veil, with off-white type on them.
Near-square corners (3–4px) throughout; flat except for cards floating on a photograph.
Press feedback on everything pressable; hover only on fine pointers; reduced motion keeps colour and opacity changes but drops movement.

rules.name: The Ink Veil Rule
rules.body: Every photograph that carries text sits under a multiply layer of ink (rgba(54, 64, 68, …)) shaped by gradients: darker where the text is, lighter in between. Never a grey or black scrim, never desaturation.

rules.name: The Slate Means Interactive Rule
rules.body: Slate marks what can be acted on or is selected: links, focus, the chosen filter or tab, button hover. It does not appear as decoration or body text.

rules.name: The Owner's Palette Rule
rules.body: Text, rules, buttons and dark surfaces come only from ink, ink-2, slate, mute and line. Paper, cream and plate are the only light grounds.

rules.name: The Untouched Logo Rule
rules.body: The SACC mark, the full lockup in the footer and the seven approving bodies' logos are shown in their own colours, only resized. Never recoloured or redrawn.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Heading Rule
rules.body: A section heading is split in two: the first part in ink, the rest in Mute Grey. The muted part takes its own line only when each line keeps at least two words; joiners (and, of, in, و, في, من…) never end the ink part.

rules.name: The Display-Face Boundary Rule
rules.body: El Messiri is for headings, titles, figures, the quote, the brand name, project titles, drawer links and journey years. Everything else, including buttons and labels, is Tajawal.

rules.name: The Scaled Arabic Rule
rules.body: Arabic gets taller line-heights (headings 1.4–1.5, body inherited at 1.7 on a larger size, quote 1.8) and no letter-spacing. Numerals, phone numbers and ISO numbers are isolated LTR with tabular lining figures.

rules.name: The Logical Properties Rule
rules.body: Inline layout uses `inline-start/end`, `margin-inline` and `padding-inline` only. Anything with a physical direction (arrows, the marquee's travel, hover nudges) is multiplied by `--dir` (-1 in RTL, 1 in LTR).

rules.name: The Only-On-A-Photo Rule
rules.body: A drop shadow appears only on a white card that floats over a photograph. Nothing on paper casts a shadow.

rules.name: The One Contact Action Rule
rules.body: One contact action («تواصل معنا» / Contact us) is visible at a time. On the home page the bar's copy appears only after the hero's own has scrolled away; on the contact page the form stands in for it. Sections never repeat it.

dos: **Do** set new content on white paper in ink, with Ink Two for secondary text and slate only for what is interactive or selected.
**Do** put a list of comparable items in ruled columns: a 1px ink rule on top, 16px gap, title in El Messiri, text in Tajawal, no fill.
**Do** split section headings into two tones, ink then Mute Grey, using the shared heading component.
**Do** keep small text on the three-step scale (12 / 13 / 14px; 13 / 14 / 15px in Arabic).
**Do** put text on a photograph only under the ink multiply veil, in paper.
**Do** give every pressable element a scale press, keep hover inside `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`, and keep a 44px hit area on touch.
**Do** write layout with logical properties and multiply directional motion by `--dir`.
**Do** show approving bodies only by their own logos, uncoloured, at an equal visual area.
donts: **Don't** fill columns with beige or grey plates; the owner rejected them as sticky notes.
**Don't** use pills, large radii or heavy shadows; the only drop shadow is on a white card over a photograph.
**Don't** use stone, teal, warm, deco or plate-2 as surfaces; they are declared but retired.
**Don't** add a second contact action to a section, or a sitemap footer.
**Don't** use Mute Grey for body-size text, or Line for any text.
**Don't** bring back a fleet page or fleet nav item.
**Don't** add small uppercase labels above new section headings. The four home section heads that show one do so by an earlier owner choice; it is not a pattern to extend.
**Don't** recolour, redraw or tint the SACC logo or any body's logo.
**Don't** invent testimonials, certificate numbers, client logos or figures.
